snippet.title: Jupiter Junkworks | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Strap in and slam down for Jupiter Junkworks, a fast-paced and action-packed arcade puzzle game where you’ll work hard to complete contracts and earn resources to rebuild your run-down spaceship junkyard. Crush, compress and manipulate blocks one moment, and enjoy a sci-fi narrative with a memorable cast and plenty of intrigue the next! Jupiter Junkworks launches into early access in October 2025!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913540/Jupiter_Junkworks/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
